cocycle_consequence: Standard Klein cocycle Sklyanin: Z3 is zero except original translation order3 or6; then it is one-dimensional and factors linear times quadratic. No H3.
twisted_quantum_theorem: Any single-automorphism Zhang twist of a skew polynomial AS4 with W1!=0 is itself a diagonal twist, hence skew. No extra H3 objects.
sklyanin_twist_theorem: For proper elliptic standard S with nondegenerate central quadric pencil, every automorphism twist with W1!=0 is a scalar/even-sign twist, isomorphic to another standard Sklyanin, hence excluded.
verified_sign_case: epsilon=(1,1,-1,-1), rescale=(1,-i bc,i c,b), beta=b²,gamma=c²; parameters map(alpha,beta,gamma)->(alpha,beta^-1,gamma^-1)
scope: Exact all-parameter quadratic relation-space transport; W1 eigenvector, Newton normalizers and full exclusions are ordinary proofs.
